caption_L1: Here a line diagram is named Consumption of coal in the United States from 1990 to 2019 , by sector (in trillion British thermal units). There is a linear scale of range 0 to 20,000 on the y-axis, marked Electric power sector. On the x-axis, Year is measured.
caption_L2L3: Consumption of coal increased between 1990 and 2005. Since 2005 the trend has broadly been for a reduction in the use of coal. The amount of coal used in 2020 is half of that used in 2005.
